name: Boerne
seo_title: Boerne Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 17 Events, 4 Free
seo_desc: 17 Christmas events for kids in Boerne, TX for 2026, 4 free: Dickens on Main, Jones CHRISTmas Ranch lights, Santa breakfasts and the Weihnachts Parade.
lede: Boerne turns its Hill Country Mile into a storybook Christmas each year, with snow on Main Street, a lighted German parade and a kids' weekend of Santa hunts. Around town, ranches add drive-through and walk-through light shows.
celebrates: Boerne celebrates Christmas over three weekends on Main Street. Dickens on Main opens the season on Thanksgiving weekend, with four themed villages, snow blowing along the Hill Country Mile, ice carving, trackless trains and visits with Santa, and the official tree lighting at Main Plaza on Friday evening. The Weihnachts Parade follows on the first Saturday night of December, a lighted parade that honors the German roots of the town. Kinder Fest closes the season with a child-friendly weekend of Santa hunts and cookies, when families are invited to come in ugly sweaters, silly pajamas and Whoville hairdos.
lastyear: In 2025, Dickens on Main ran November 28 and 29 for its 25th year. New that year was a tailored version of The Nutcracker by the Greater San Antonio Academy of Ballet, and the 22-foot ice slide came back for kids. Castle Brass led carols before the Friday tree lighting. The Weihnachts Parade on December 6 sent more than 100 lighted floats down Main Street, and Kinder Fest ran December 12 to 14 with a Cookie Crawl and a Santa Scavenger Hunt.
facts: Boerne is pronounced burnie, and German settlers founded it around 1851. Dickens on Main is inspired by A Christmas Carol, the Charles Dickens story first published in London in 1843, so the villages carry names like Tiny Tim. City officials counted more than 48,000 visitors at Dickens on Main in 2024, and 75 percent came from outside the 78006 zip code. In 2026 the Hallmark Channel named Boerne one of 25 finalists in its Merriest Christmas Town contest, and it was the only Texas town on the list.
trains: The first San Antonio and Aransas Pass passenger train reached Boerne on March 12, 1887, carrying more than 600 people from San Antonio for 95 cents each. It cut a stagecoach trip of over seven hours to about three. The line went on to Kerrville, and Southern Pacific ended service in 1971. Today part of the old route is a nature walk with shelters styled after the railroad. The nearest Amtrak stop is the San Antonio station at 350 Hoefgen Street, served by the Sunset Limited and the Texas Eagle.

faq: What is Boerne's biggest Christmas tradition?

Dickens on Main, held every Thanksgiving weekend on the Hill Country Mile. Main Street closes to cars and becomes four themed villages, North Pole, Dickens, South Pole and Tiny Tim, with snow, ice carving shows, live music, trackless trains for kids and visits with Santa. The town tree is lit on the Friday night of the festival.
When is the Weihnachts Parade in Boerne?

The Weihnachts Parade is held on the first Saturday night of December. It celebrates the German roots of Boerne, and in 2025 more than 100 lighted floats rolled down Main Street. Families can bring chairs to sit along the route, and the parade has also been streamed online by GVTC for anyone who cannot attend.

Boerne is pronounced burnie. The name comes from the German settlers who founded the town around 1851, part of the wave of German immigration that also created towns like Fredericksburg, Comfort and Sisterdale. That German heritage still shows at Christmas, especially in the Weihnachts Parade, whose name is the German word for Christmas.
Is Boerne a Hallmark Christmas town?

In 2026 the Hallmark Channel named Boerne one of 25 finalists in its Merriest Christmas Town contest, and it was the only Texas town on the list. Hallmark said Boerne feels less like a town and more like a holiday storybook, pointing to the lights, storefronts and music along the historic Hill Country Mile.
How many people go to Dickens on Main?

City officials said more than 48,000 people came to Dickens on Main in 2024, and about 75 percent came from outside Boerne's 78006 zip code. Together, Dickens on Main and the Weihnachts Parade draw roughly 70,000 visitors over two weekends, so the city offers first come, first served parking in public lots downtown.

highlights: Swingin' with Santa at Rainbow Event Center on Friday, December 4, 3 to 6 pm, is free, with free Santa pictures, DJ music and trampolines, per the Boerne Love calendar.
The Boerne Wassail Walk and Christmas Caroling Contest fills Main Street on Friday, December 4, 4 to 8 pm, and is listed as a free event.
The Boerne Farmers Market Homegrown Holiday Festival with Santa is Tuesday, December 1, from 4 pm until dark, with a bounce house, crafts and cocoa.
God's Gift Factory at St. Mark Presbyterian Church on Saturday, December 12, lets children from infants through 5th grade make and wrap gifts for $10 per child, with registration required.
Three churches host the Christmas Churches by Candlelight Walk on Wednesday, December 2, starting at 5:30 pm at First United Methodist Church.
